authentication.title: Next.js Authentication
authentication.notes: Use middleware for route protection. Never rely on client-side auth checks alone.

headers.title: Next.js Security Headers
headers.notes: Always set CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS.

middleware.title: Next.js Middleware
middleware.notes: Use middleware to enforce auth on protected routes before page load.

server-actions.title: Next.js Server Actions Security
server-actions.notes: Server Actions are public endpoints — always validate auth and input inside them.

environment-variables.title: Next.js Environment Variables
environment-variables.notes: Never prefix server secrets with NEXT_PUBLIC_. That exposes them to the browser.

row-level-security.title: Supabase Row Level Security
row-level-security.notes: Enable RLS on every table. Default deny. Never query with service_role key from client.

authentication.title: Supabase Auth
authentication.notes: Use SSR auth helpers server-side. Never trust client-side session alone.

api-keys.title: Supabase API Keys & Security
api-keys.notes: anon key is safe for client. service_role key must NEVER be exposed client-side.

storage-security.title: Supabase Storage Security
storage-security.notes: Storage buckets are public by default. Set policies to restrict access.

security-rules.title: Firebase Security Rules
security-rules.notes: Default rules deny all. Write rules before going to production.

authentication.title: Firebase Authentication
authentication.notes: Always verify ID tokens server-side using Firebase Admin SDK.

firestore-rules.title: Firestore Security Rules
firestore-rules.notes: Never use allow read, write: if true in production. Always scope by auth.uid.

sql-injection.title: Prisma Raw Queries Safety
sql-injection.notes: Use $queryRaw with Prisma.sql template tag. Never string-interpolate user input into raw queries.

middleware.title: Prisma Middleware & Access Control
middleware.notes: Use Prisma extensions to enforce access control at the query layer.

helmet.title: Express Security Best Practices (Helmet)
helmet.notes: Always use helmet middleware. Disable x-powered-by. Use rate limiting.

input-validation.title: Express Input Validation
input-validation.notes: Validate and sanitize all user input with express-validator or zod.

authentication.title: Express JWT Authentication
authentication.notes: Verify JWT on every protected route. Use httpOnly cookies, not localStorage.

xss.title: React XSS Prevention
xss.notes: Never use dangerouslySetInnerHTML with user content. React escapes by default — don't bypass it.

dependencies.title: React Security Considerations
dependencies.notes: Regularly audit third-party React component libraries for vulnerabilities.
